fullName.value: Neural precursor cell expressed developmentally down-regulated protein 1

texts.value: Required for mitosis progression. Promotes the nucleation of microtubules from the spindle
Interacts with FAM29A (PubMed:19029337). Interacts with HSPA1A and HSPA1B. Interacts with gamma-tubulin in a HSPA1A/B-dependent manner (PubMed:27137183)

location.value: Cytoplasm, cytoskeleton, microtubule organizing center, centrosome

texts.value: During mitosis, prior phosphorylation on Thr-550 by CDK1 promotes subsequent phosphorylation by PLK1 on Thr-382, Ser-397, Ser-426 and Ser-637. Phosphorylated NEDD1 can interact with gamma-tubulin for targeting the gamma-tubulin ring complex (gTuRC) to the centrosome, an important step for spindle formation
